verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM says every document joins the agent's knowledge base and ships 'chat with your docs' with RAG out of the box, backed by configurable embedders and vector stores. A hands-on user ran it over a batch of regulatory PDFs and got largely correct answers, though the citations window showed garbled content. missing for 10: reliable source-citation display for grounded answers, in-depth first-party docs on ingestion (supported file types and notes).
